purpose: Teach: 演歌/林檎/車庫/国宝/大西洋/スリル/毛皮/ビーフ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが演歌のレコードをくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa gave you that enka record, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Soft smile in the voice. Not quite a question—more like a gentle sharing of something she's noticed. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの林檎パイ食べたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to have Grandma's apple pie.
lines.style: Bright, direct request. A little lift at the end—hoping for a yes. Genuine want, not whining. The naturalness of a child stating his heart.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが車庫の電気を直してらしたわ
lines.en: You know, your dad got the garage light working again.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful delivery. Like she's noticing the small quiet competence of someone she loves. Pause before the main thought—letting him settle in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、修学旅行で国宝の建物見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw a national treasure building on my school trip!
lines.style: Excitement bursting at the edges, but contained. Pride in having witnessed something real and old. Quick pace, bright attack on 'saw.' Wanting her to understand how special it was.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔、大西洋を旅されたお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Your father told me once about a trip he took across the Atlantic, long ago.
lines.style: Reflective, almost dreamy. She's remembering him remembering. Soft pace. A little distance in time, warmth in the telling. Like she's handing him a piece of his father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祭りでスリルあるお化け屋敷入ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went into a haunted house at the festival—it was so scary!
lines.style: Quick, eager delivery. Energy bouncing between fear and thrill. Wants her reaction—her reassurance wrapped in his own retelling. Slight breathlessness, like he's still buzzing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの毛皮の襟巻きが温かそうね
lines.en: Your grandmother's fur collar looks so warm.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself. Noticing the texture and comfort of something familiar. Slow, gentle pace. A small moment of appreciation for the people and objects she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ママのビーフシチュー一番好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I love your beef stew the most of anything.
lines.style: Direct, sincere declaration. No performance—just the truth of it. Soft, steady voice. A moment where the child's affection lands without needing embellishment.
